shots.vo: Quick question... when someone new to Washington City searches for what you do... do they find you?
This town grew up along the Virgin River... Settled in eighteen fifty-seven, by families sent here to grow cotton.
The Washington Cotton Factory, built in eighteen sixty-five, still stands here. It's on the National Register of Historic Places.
I live here too... along the same river. I'm Seth Shoultes, and I help local businesses get found online... and get more done with AI.
It's a young, busy place. About thirty-two thousand three hundred people... and about thirteen thousand seven hundred fifty homes.
Many people here are new to town. New neighbors search for a plumber, a dentist, or a landscaper. The business with a clear page and good reviews is the one they call.
I offer AI services with SEO built in. Content, media, and interactive websites, made to be found.
I've worked on search for almost twenty years. I owned a website development agency... and I worked inside a marketing department.
In Southern Utah, I bought a garage door company, and took it to number one within three months. Then I sold it to a competitor.
That's the playbook for a business in Washington City... So let's start with a call about your business. Seth Shoultes dot com.
